symptom: `show message … type error` stored Microflows$ShowMessageAction Type "error"; the runtime showed an Information dialog for an error message while `mx check` reported 0 errors (mendixlabs/mxcli#1280). `type ok` was stored as "ok" the same way
cause: buildShowMessageStatement copied the `identifierOrKeyword` text verbatim; the stored enumeration value is case-sensitive and nothing between the visitor and the writer validated it
insight: **An enum value taken from a free-form `identifierOrKeyword` needs case-folding to the gen enum's spelling AND a check for non-members** — skills write keywords in lower case, so the lower-case spelling is the common one, and `mx check` accepts any string for an enumeration property, so neither mx check nor a build catches it; only the stored bytes or the running app do. Normalise in the visitor (so declared-vs-described AST comparison agrees) and again in the writer. Verified on 11.12.4: the pre-fix binary stores `Type = error`, the fixed one `Error`, and `docker check` passes both. Grep other `identifierOrKeyword` enum slots for the same shape
